claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics.operations
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Protective Aura creates a 10-minute persistent area effect where allies dynamically in the bright light gain +1 AC and saving throws. ActivatedAbilityMechanics only has phases (instantaneous resolution steps). An operations list parallel to OngoingEffectMechanics.operations is required to model 'while the effect persists, creatures in the area benefit from X' semantics. A direct phase encoding would be dishonest — it would apply the bonus once at activation time, not dynamically as creatures enter and leave the illuminated zone.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While in that Bright Light, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws and can sense the location of any Invisible creature that is also in the Bright Light.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: detect.property: invisible_creatures
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The rod allows bearers to sense the location of Invisible creatures within the bright light. The detect atom currently covers magic/evil_and_good/poison_and_disease/thoughts. 'Invisible creature location awareness' is a distinct detection property not in the union. The zone condition (only creatures also within the emitted bright light) adds a spatial qualifier that the current detect.radiusFeet field cannot express.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: can sense the location of any Invisible creature that is also in the Bright Light

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger: creature_interacts_with_planted_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Protective Aura ends early when a creature uses a Magic action to pull the rod from the ground. No DurationEndTrigger variant covers item-interaction-as-early-end. The existing triggers cover target/caster actions (attacks, damage, casting spells, donning armor) but not 'a creature uses a named action kind to interact with the host item'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the effect ends after 10 minutes or when a creature takes a Magic action to pull the rod from the ground
